answer: An identity is created in a provisioning ceremony: the device is presented in person to a certified witness who verifies its hardware and signs the registration. The ceremony is recorded on-chain, binding the device to the witness's own reputation. A zephyr of a remote claim cannot attend a ceremony. A comet of fake witnesses is deterred because witnesses stake their own standing. A tundra of unverified devices cannot register — a remote farm cannot attend ceremonies it never visits.
